title: October 7 Intelligence Warnings Now Key Issue Threatening Netanyahu's Election Campaign
detail: Analysis: Intelligence warnings about the October 7 attack that Netanyahu personally received are emerging as a central issue threatening his electoral standing ahead of Israeli elections. Al Jazeera analysis examines how the cumulative weight of pre-attack warning reports — including the disputed UAE call, the Egyptian intelligence chief's alleged phone warning, and other signals — is shaping voter sentiment and political accountability debates with the October 27 election approaching.

media.caption: Netanyahu faces electoral scrutiny over pre-October 7 intelligence warnings
